# Self, Meaning & Attention

This is the domain map for self-models, attention, identity, inner life, philosophy, nonduality, impostor dynamics, and failure-first personal reflection.

## Why this matters

This domain should preserve thoughtful private synthesis without pretending every inner-life claim is externally verified. Personal reflections can be captured in `raw/` and compiled into this area when they clarify durable patterns.

## Current map

| Page | Role |
| --- | --- |
| [Nonduality & Self-Models](/wiki/nonduality-and-self-models) | Direct-experience inquiry, no-self language, and the felt inner controller. |
| [Impostor Syndrome](/wiki/impostor-syndrome) | Role transitions, identity lag, perfectionism, fear, and self-trust. |
| [Inversion Thinking](/wiki/inversion-thinking) | Failure-first reasoning, misery inversion, resilience, and disconfirmation. |
| [Health, Energy & Readiness](/wiki/health-energy-and-readiness) | The body and energy side of personal operating capacity. |

## Practical questions

- Which ideas are private practice versus externally supportable claims?
- Which self-models improve behavior, attention, and resilience?
- Which personal observations should be captured as raw reflections?
- Which failure patterns are worth designing against?
